rows.verbatim_source: Interestingly, no association of PTX3 SNPs and infectious events such as IFD was found in this non-transplant setting.
rows.note: Conference abstract. Only a collective qualitative null statement for all PTX3 SNPs; no per-variant genetic model, alleles, genotype counts, estimate or p-value. Outcome is infectious events including IFD, not specifically invasive aspergillosis or mould.

paper_note: EHA 2017 conference abstract (P648) on 186 non-transplant AML patients after induction chemotherapy. It reports only a pooled qualitative null result for the PTX3 SNPs and infectious events including IFD, with no per-variant numbers; the L-ficolin results given are for sepsis and pneumonia, not IFD.
